svg.title: Where helmstudio keeps files on disk
svg.desc: A directory tree. Under a helmstudio directory in your home directory: helm.db, holding all the state; an assets blobs directory, holding each file's bytes once, named by sha256; a library directory, the same bytes under names you can browse; a cache derived directory, holding thumbnails and posters, which are regenerable; a models directory, holding weights that were downloaded or linked; a stage directory, where a studio writes before its output is adopted; and a studios directory, holding one clone per studio, or nothing when a manifest's local_path points at a checkout you already have. Five roots — data, cache, logs, library and models — each move with their own environment variable. Below, separately: running helm dev instead puts the same shape in a .helm directory beside the manifest.
svg.text: a clone, or your own checkout
Five roots — data, cache, logs, library, models — each
move with an environment variable of their own.
Linked weights and a local_path checkout stay where
they are: a symlink points out, nothing is copied in.
the same shape, beside the manifest
